title: Effectiveness of cone-beam computed tomography-generated cephalograms using artificial intelligence cephalometric analysis
summary: Measurements were compared in 30 participants, supporting a bounded imaging-agreement result. The small study does not establish improved patient outcomes or performance across broader clinical populations.
ai_technology: An AI cephalometric system generates cephalograms from cone-beam CT for comparison with conventional measurements.
organization: Department of Conservative Dentistry, Hallym University Sacred Heart Hospital, Anyang, Korea

evidence.tested: Measurements were compared in 30 participants, supporting a bounded imaging-agreement result.
evidence.unknown: The small study does not establish improved patient outcomes or performance across broader clinical populations.
